title: Loving Your Neighbor
definition: Loving your neighbor means seeking the good of others through compassion, truth, mercy, service, and practical care.
summary: Neighbor love reaches beyond convenience and favoritism. It reflects God's love toward people made in His image.
christFocus: Christ perfectly loved His neighbor and teaches His people to love even the overlooked, wounded, and difficult.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Neighbor love reaches beyond convenience and favoritism. It reflects God's love toward people made in His image.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
